messages:
Jordan Lee: FYI deploying inference-runtime v3.3.1 to prod tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Canary 10% -> 50% after 30m -> 100% at 60m if OK. Need smoke owners and rollback standby.
Maria Chen: I can own smoke for the first 60m. I'll watch latency, error-rate, and tokens/sec. Will post quick checks every 10m.
Raj Patel: I'll be rollback owner for the window. Rollback playbook updated in runbook v3.3.1 (link in docs). Confirmed pinned tag v3.3.0 exists.
Sasha Ivanov: Quick code-review note — the canary toggle PR got merged but left the debug flag off. Confirming this is intentional?
Jordan Lee: Yes intentional — debug off for perf parity. We verified 95th p99 latency on canary earlier.
Maria Chen: Smoke checklist I'm planning to run:
1) sanity generate (see cmd)
2) p99 latency < 400ms
3) error rate < 0.5%
4) KV cache hit ratio unchanged (~>85%)
5) no new exceptions in logs

Commands:
```
# sanity gen
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"smoke test","max_tokens":8}' https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate | jq .
```

Jordan Lee: Also run the load-smoke script to validate batching: `scripts/load-smoke.sh --qps 20 --duration 120`
Raj Patel: Rollback steps (short):
1) Pause rollout (console)
2) Trigger rollback action
3) Re-pin routing to tag v3.3.0
4) Validate smoke green

CLI snippet:
```
redwood deploy rollback --service inference-runtime --to-tag v3.3.0 --reason "post-canary regressions"
```

Sasha Ivanov: Quick ask — can we get an extra eyes on the model-quant config? I can review at 01:30 UTC.
Jordan Lee: @Sasha sounds good. @Maria will you be able to verify quant metrics during the initial canary?
Maria Chen: Yep, I'll post the three datapoints every 10m: latency, error-rate, cache-hit.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: inference-runtime v3.3.1 for 2024-11-21T02:00:00Z (canary 10%). Created incident stub #IR-3792 for tracking.

oncall-rotation: Oncall is Raj Patel for this window. He will escalate to infra if rollback is needed.

Jordan Lee: Sign-offs needed before we hit the window: L2 operations, rollback owner, canary owner, QA lead. Reply with thumbs up when ready.
Maria Chen: :white_check_mark: smoke owner (Maria)
Raj Patel: :white_check_mark: rollback owner (Raj)
Sasha Ivanov: :white_check_mark: QA/code review (Sasha)
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup: L2 ops (Jordan) — scheduling the deploy slot.

Jordan Lee: I'll post a final preflight message 15m before start with the quick checklist and links to dashboards.
Maria Chen: Thanks — will have alerts muted only for noisy logs and keep paging on errors.
Raj Patel: Ready on my side. If anything goes wrong we follow the rollback steps and notify @infra.
Sasha Ivanov: Good to go from QA.

Jordan Lee: Closing thread for async sign-offs. If anything changes, ping here or DM.
